Description: NREL ATB scenario selection. ATB carries every (scenario, model_case) for each carrier — these settings choose which slice ``load_costs`` uses.
Global default ATB cost trajectory. ``Advanced`` = optimistic / fastest cost decline; ``Conservative`` = pessimistic. See :ref:`data-costs`.
Global default. ``Market`` bakes current policy incentives (PTC/ITC) into financing; ``R&D`` strips them out for a pure-learning view.

Optional per-carrier overrides. Keys are pypsa-names (``solar``, ``onwind``, ``nuclear``, ``CCGT``, ``4hr_battery_storage``, …); each value may set ``scenario`` and/or ``model_case``. Anything unset falls back to the global default.
EIA AEO fuel-cost scenario.
AEO case used to fetch projected fuel costs for the requested year.
Discount rate used for weighting multi-investment objective function values.
Vintage year of the CAISO natural-gas hub prices used for wholesale gas costs.
Specify exogenous prices for emission types listed in ``network.carriers`` to marginal costs.

Add cost for a carbon-dioxide price configured in ``costs: emission_prices: co2`` to ``marginal_cost`` of generators (other emission types listed in ``network.carriers`` possible as well). Can also be set via the ``Ep`` keyword in the ``{opts}`` wildcard.
Exogenous flat price of carbon-dioxide added to the marginal costs of fossil-fuelled generators according to their carbon intensity.
Request a monthly carbon-price time series instead of the flat ``co2`` price above (``Ept`` opts keyword). Parsed, but monthly pricing is not yet implemented — it falls back to the static price.
Production Tax Credit, subtracted from the marginal cost of the listed carriers.
Per-carrier PTC value (e.g. ``onwind``, ``biomass``).
Investment Tax Credit, applied as a fractional reduction of the capital cost of the listed carriers.
Per-carrier ITC fraction (e.g. ``solar``, ``offwind_floating``, ``EGS``, ``4hr_battery_storage``, ``8hr_PHS``).
Earliest commercial-availability year per carrier; the carrier is excluded from investment periods before this year.
Per-carrier first-available year.
Optional per-carrier annual build-rate caps limiting how fast a technology can be deployed.
Base build rate in MW and fractional annual growth allowed on top of it.
